methods.label: No mitigation (aware)
methods.about: The model sees every feature, including the sensitive one.

methods.label: Fairness through unawareness
methods.about: The sensitive column is simply removed. Proxies can still carry the signal.

methods.label: Reweighing (aware)
methods.about: Training rows are re-weighted so group and outcome look independent; the attribute stays an input.

methods.label: Blind + Reweighing (deployed)
methods.about: What the dashboard ships: no sensitive input, reweighed training.

methods.label: Group thresholds (thesis)
methods.about: Per-group cut-offs chosen on a validation split: minimise the FPR gap, then the TPR gap, then maximise F1.

methods.about: Fairlearn's Hardt-style post-processing for equalized odds.
